messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. Our orders with you for part:340010 rose from EUR 28.94 (po:4500010364-10) to EUR 29.89 (po:4500010407-10) between 2023-12-27 and 2024-01-05. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

You prioritise firm, long-term commitments. Our attached packages give you 23400 pcs per year, binding for 36 or 24 months. That secures your capacity planning.

What is the earliest lead time you can confirm? Could your pricing committee review these packages?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, your should-cost estimate does not reflect the realities of our specialized manufacturing processes. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We acknowledge your volume forecast and confirm a lead time of 56 days for the 36-month commitment. The verified volume increase has been factored into our revised price of EUR 31.50. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Part 340010 – 23400 pcs per year, 36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for verifying our data.

To answer your question: we commit to 23400 pcs per year, binding for 36 months, at your standard payment terms. This is the firm, long-term commitment you said you would prioritise in your e-mails of 18 September and 27 March. It covers your full capacity planning for three years.

We have moved our price in both attached packages. The first keeps the 56-day lead time you confirmed. The second uses our 42-day standard lead time, which spares both sides expediting work.

Which of the two can you confirm?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010 – 23400 pcs per year, 36-month commitment
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your commitment to the 36-month term and 23400 units. We maintain the 56-day lead time and adjust our price to EUR 31.40. 

Consequently, our offer stands at a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please provide data substantiating your claim regarding expediting work.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
